en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 13. Muḥammad ibn Ya’qūb narrated to me from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdil Jabbār, from Safwān, from Ibn Muskān, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
Those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) knowing his rights will be forgiven for all of their past and future sins.
